DOMESTIC_WATER_QUALITY.rule: Water used for domestic purposes must satisfy applicable current quality requirements; historical taste/clarity claims never substitute for testing.
DOMESTIC_WATER_QUALITY.scope_note: Not drinking-water-at-tap regulation; use the QCVN's stated scope.

INTERNAL_WATER_SUPPLY.rule: Use for internal water-supply design within its scope; do not replace engineering tank/pump sizing with Feng Shui.

INTERNAL_DRAINAGE.rule: Internal drainage design must follow applicable technical requirements; no ancient 'straight/branching' taboo can override hydraulic/sanitary design.

EXTERNAL_WATER_SUPPLY.rule: Source protection, treatment, distribution and storage belong to modern infrastructure engineering.

EXTERNAL_DRAINAGE.rule: Stormwater/wastewater networks, flood resilience, treatment and lawful outlet take precedence.
EXTERNAL_DRAINAGE.climate_note: Current drainage design explicitly considers climate-change/flooding context.

HAZARDOUS_HISTORICAL_PRACTICE.rule: Any introduction of lead or other toxic material to a drinking-water source is INVALID_FOR_APPLICATION regardless of historical source.
